newsitem.title: USA: Consumers 780 MW Mich. nuke near full power.
newsitem.headline: Consumers 780 MW Mich. nuke near full power.

text.p: CMS Energy's 780 megawatt Palisades nuclear power plant was nearing full power output early Thursday as it returned from a repair outage, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The unit, located in South Haven, Mich., was operating at 93 percent of capacity and continued to increase power, the NRC said Thursday in its daily plant status report.
The unit was being ramped up from a repair outage which began last week.
Palisades produces 18 percent of Consumers Energy's total power output.
Consumers Energy is a subsidiary of CMS Energy Corp.
